task.description:
REQ-149 is a design-only requirement that adds a single markdown file. No Elixir code was changed. There are no new functions or modules to test.

For this type of requirement, the test phase verifies:
1. mix test passes with 0 failures (no regressions introduced)
2. mix compile passes (no compile errors)

No new test file needs to be written -- the acceptance criteria are verified by the design doc itself (content requirements, not behavioral tests) and by the mix compile/test pass.

Your task:
1. Checkout feature/WF02-REQ149-20260826
2. Run mix compile and mix test
3. Quote the actual output summary lines
4. Report PASS if both exit 0 with 0 failures, FAIL otherwise

If mix test takes too long, run only: mix test --no-start (or use the quick compile check first). The full suite should be run, not just a subset, to confirm no regressions.

After:
1. Claim handoff, fill result with PASS/FAIL + actual test output quoted
2. Commit on main:
   git checkout main && git pull --ff-only && git add handoffs/WF02-REQ149-20260826/step-03-test-designer.json && git commit -m 'chore(TEST-DESIGNER): WF02-REQ149-20260826 step-03 PASS' && git push origin main
acceptance_criteria: mix compile exits 0 on the feature branch
mix test exits 0 with 0 failures (full suite, actual output quoted)
